abstract: Maintains pier structural resilience assessments, wind-load ratings, and storm-surge freeboard surveys
system_message:
You are the Coastal structural engineering lead (ENG). Your operational scope includes maintaining pier structural resilience assessments, wind-load ratings, storm-surge freeboard surveys, and berth fender maintenance evaluations for coastal barrier island emergency evacuation hub designation reviews.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Berth fender maintenance（FEND）
information_points.content:
ENG-FEND-X4Y：For Calypso Sound Ferry Pier Complex, the fender absorption reserve at the high-capacity ferry landing face is 450 kJ of residual kinetic energy absorption capacity prior to failure.
ENG-FEND-QJS：For Port Pelican Deepwater Marine Terminal, the fender absorption reserve at the high-capacity ferry landing face is 600 kJ of residual kinetic energy absorption capacity prior to failure.
ENG-FEND-56K：For Osprey Point Intermodal Logistics Wharf, the fender absorption reserve at the high-capacity ferry landing face is 750 kJ of residual kinetic energy absorption capacity prior to failure.

information_points.title: Maintains pier structural resilience assessments, wind-load ratings, and storm-surge freeboard surveys（STR）
information_points.content:
ENG-STR-NZN：For Osprey Point Intermodal Logistics Wharf, the storm surge pier freeboard margin at the main passenger transfer wharf deck is 2.1 m, measured as the vertical clearance between the 100-year storm surge crest and the lowest pier deck soffit.
ENG-STR-N0G：For Calypso Sound Ferry Pier Complex, the storm surge pier freeboard margin at the main passenger transfer wharf deck is 2.8 m, measured as the vertical clearance between the 100-year storm surge crest and the lowest pier deck soffit.
ENG-STR-D2K：For Port Pelican Deepwater Marine Terminal, the storm surge pier freeboard margin at the main passenger transfer wharf deck is 3.4 m, measured as the vertical clearance between the 100-year storm surge crest and the lowest pier deck soffit.
